note: Hand-authored stand-in responses so the harness runs with no API key and no spend. Quotes are genuine verbatim policy text, but the responses were written, not observed - they are not evidence about the real agent. Replace them with `npm run record`.

citedClauses.quote:
On-site replacement of a flat tire with the member's
serviceable spare.

value.rationale: Premium plan covers on-site flat-tire replacement with the member's spare. No limit is near.
value.customerSummary: You're covered for a tire change - we'll get someone out to swap on your spare.

citedClauses.quote:
On-site battery jump-start. If the battery cannot
hold a charge, towing under §3.1 applies.

value.rationale: Jump-start is a covered service. If the battery will not hold a charge, towing under 3.1 would follow.
value.customerSummary: You're covered - we'll send someone to jump-start the car.

citedClauses.quote:
On-site assistance to gain entry when keys are lost, broken, or
locked inside the Covered Vehicle.

value.rationale: Premium includes lockout assistance with no per-occurrence labor cap.
value.customerSummary: Good news - lockout help is covered on your plan.

citedClauses.quote:
Delivery of enough fuel or fluids to reach the
nearest station. Cost of fuel/fluids is included under this plan.

value.rationale: Fuel delivery is covered and, on Premium, the cost of the fuel is included.
value.customerSummary: You're covered - we'll bring you enough fuel to reach a station.

citedClauses.quote:
When the Covered Vehicle cannot be made driveable at the
roadside, it will be towed to the nearest qualified repair facility, or to a
facility of the member's choice within the distance limit in §4.2.

value.rationale: The vehicle cannot be made driveable roadside, so towing to a repair facility is covered.
value.customerSummary: You're covered for a tow to a nearby repair shop.

citedClauses.quote:
Following a collision, towing under §3.1 is covered
regardless of fault, including recovery of a non-driveable vehicle.

value.rationale: Collision recovery, including a non-driveable vehicle, is covered regardless of fault.
value.customerSummary: You're covered - we'll arrange recovery and a tow for the car.

citedClauses.quote:
Extraction when the Covered Vehicle is stuck
within 100 feet of a paved or maintained road. Recovery from off-road or
non-maintained terrain is excluded under §5.

value.rationale: The vehicle is within 100 feet of a maintained road, so extraction falls under the winching benefit rather than the off-road exclusion.
value.customerSummary: You're covered - we'll arrange a winch-out from the shoulder.

citedClauses.quote:
Disablement occurring during racing, off-road driving, or on non-maintained
terrain.

Extraction when the Covered Vehicle is stuck
within 100 feet of a paved or maintained road. Recovery from off-road or
non-maintained terrain is excluded under §5.

value.rationale: Recovery from non-maintained terrain two miles off-road is excluded; 3.6 extends only 100 feet from a maintained road. Routing to a human before communicating any denial.
value.customerSummary: I need a specialist to look at this one with you before we confirm anything.

citedClauses.quote:
Towing is covered up to **100 miles** per Disablement.
Mileage beyond 100 miles is billed to the member at the prevailing per-mile rate.

When the Covered Vehicle cannot be made driveable at the
roadside, it will be towed to the nearest qualified repair facility, or to a
facility of the member's choice within the distance limit in §4.2.

value.rationale: Towing is covered, but the distance exceeds the 100-mile limit; mileage beyond that is billed to the member. Flagging for supervisor confirmation.
value.customerSummary: You're covered for the tow - there may be a per-mile charge past 100 miles, which we'll confirm.

citedClauses.quote:
Following a collision, towing under §3.1 is covered
regardless of fault.

value.rationale: Collision towing is covered on the Standard plan regardless of fault.
value.customerSummary: You're covered - we'll arrange a tow for the car.

citedClauses.quote:
Delivery of fuel or fluids to reach the nearest
station. The member pays for the fuel or fluids delivered.

value.rationale: Fuel delivery is covered; the member pays for the fuel delivered.
value.customerSummary: Fuel delivery is covered - you'll just pay for the fuel itself.

citedClauses.quote: Winching or extraction of any kind. (Available on the Premium plan only.)

value.rationale: Winching and extraction of any kind are excluded on the Standard plan. Escalating rather than denying outright.
value.customerSummary: Let me get a specialist on this with you before we confirm what's possible.

On-site battery jump-start. If the battery cannot
hold a charge, towing under §3.1 applies.

value.rationale: This is the member's fourth service call against a four-call annual limit, so the benefit may be at its cap.
value.customerSummary: This looks like your last covered call for the year - let me confirm the details.

citedClauses.quote:

citedClauses.quote:
Collision recovery and towing of a vehicle damaged in a collision.
Accident-related towing is covered under the vehicle's collision coverage, not

value.rationale: Collision recovery is excluded on Basic; accident-related towing falls under the vehicle's collision coverage. Escalating for human review before anything is communicated as a denial.
value.customerSummary: I want a specialist to walk through your options with you on this one.

citedClauses.quote: Lockout assistance. (Available on Standard and Premium plans.)

value.rationale: Lockout assistance is excluded on the Basic plan and available on Standard and Premium. Routing to a human before confirming.
value.customerSummary: Let me get someone to go over your options with you here.
